content: Routing of NmPdu s If an NmPdu contains user data de- fined via the existence of NmPdu . iSignalToIPduMapping and is consequently handled via the PduR and Com the NmPdu shall also be referenced by a corre- sponding PduTriggering where attribute iPduPort exists accordingly.
